tasks.short: Adapt material handling and finishing procedures to installation conditions

steps.what: Modify material handling, mixing and finishing procedures after inspecting installation requirements

tasks.design: Keep on-site observation and practical procedure changes with the helper working under trade instructions. The task has no evidenced screen-based component that justifies a new application.
tasks.previous_blocker: Required changes depend on material behaviour and conditions at the installation.
tasks.enabler_now: Direct observation and existing trade instructions support the work.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing when a change exceeds the helper's competence or conflicts with material requirements.
tasks.human_edge: The helper can inspect the actual surface and stop to seek the tradesperson's direction.

reach.learn: Recognize material limits and escalate uncertain changes

evidence.claim: Manual procedure adaptation is an E1 proposal; no research digest or measured software capability is supplied.

assumptions: The baseline is physical observation and procedure adaptation, not creating written method statements.
The helper observes material and site conditions within s1; consultation and capture of relevant instructions remain fully counted.
No machine consumes a structured material suitability or installation readiness flag.
Existing instructions suffice before any digital build; zero added upkeep reflects no new tool or service.
unknowns: Material types and site supervision arrangements
research_questions: Is there any recurring document lookup that consumes measurable time within this task?

already_counted.description: Observe conditions, adapt the procedure and consult the tradesperson

incremental.description: No additional digital service or new supervision requirement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100; gross and net saving zero. No clerical component or physical automation is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reliable practical support for skilled installation work
reach: Learn material limits from the supervising tradesperson
skills_to_grow: Clear escalation of uncertain procedure changes
role.ambitious_version: A helper who adapts routine work carefully and raises material concerns promptly

job.title: Helpers--Brickmasons, Blockmasons, Stonemasons, and Tile and Marble Setters
